note: Live-session recording of the screen scenes (series/tools/rec). prepare/teardown run on the laptop, not recorded; commands are typed and run for real in Git Bash scripts via 'bash'.
prepare: # laptop toolchain for the bash scripts: Git Bash first on PATH, python3 and zip shims in %TEMP% (the laptop has neither)

$shim = Join-Path $env:TEMP 'mgshim'; New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force $shim | Out-Null; [IO.File]::WriteAllText("$shim\python3", "#!/bin/bash`nexec python `"`$@`"`n"); [IO.File]::WriteAllText("$shim\zip.py", "import sys,os,zipfile`nz=zipfile.ZipFile(os.path.abspath(sys.argv[-2]),'w',zipfile.ZIP_DEFLATED)`n[z.write(os.path.join(r,n),os.path.relpath(os.path.join(r,n),'.').replace(os.sep,'/')) for r,d,f in os.walk('.') for n in f]`nz.close()`n"); [IO.File]::WriteAllText("$shim\zip", "#!/bin/bash`nexec python `"`$(dirname `"`$0`")/zip.py`" `"`$@`"`n")
az account show --query name -o none 2>$null; if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { az login --use-device-code }   # owner signs in as labadmin
if (-not $env:ALERT_EMAIL) { throw 'Set ALERT_EMAIL (the recorder mailbox) before recording; it must not be shown on screen' }
bash infra/deploy.sh rg-contoso-monitoring swedencentral   # about 8 minutes
bash infra/load.sh $env:APP_URL 100   # about 2 minutes of mixed traffic
Start-Sleep -Seconds 300   # telemetry ingestion is not instant
# portal check before recording: Logs > AppRequests | take 5 | project AppRoleName must be contoso-orders-api (the alert query filters on it); if not, stop and tell the episode builder

screens.name: transaction
steps: Open rg-contoso-monitoring > the Application Insights resource > Investigate > Transaction search
Filter Event types to Request, open a POST /orders with result 201

In the end-to-end transaction details show the request, the child orders.price span (properties order.channel, order.line_count, order.total) and the Azure blob dependency (PUT to the orders container)
mask: tenant name/domain in the top bar and account menu
Application Insights, storage account and workspace names

screens.name: orders-by-channel
steps: Open rg-contoso-monitoring > Log Analytics workspace > Logs (close the query-picker dialog)
Paste queries/orders-by-channel.kql and run it: a timechart with two series, web and partner
Optional second tab: queries/sampling-check.kql showing RetainedPercentage (expect values at or near 100; say what was captured)
mask: tenant name/domain in the top bar and account menu

screens.name: alert-fired
commands: $n = 0; do { Start-Sleep -Seconds 5; $code = curl.exe -s -o NUL -w "%{http_code}" "$env:APP_URL/healthz"; $n++ } until ($code -eq '200' -or $n -ge 40)   # the app restarts after the setting change
mask: the ALERT_EMAIL value must never appear

steps: About 5-10 minutes after the load: Azure Monitor > Alerts
Show the fired alert-orders-failed-requests (Sev 2) and alert-orders-failure-ratio with dimension OperationName = POST /orders
Optional: the alert e-mail (mask the address)

screens.note: The tally shows HTTP 500 lines next to 201/400/404/422. The Azure Monitor Alerts blade (right half of the capture) is a browser capture done after the terminal scene; the kit records only the terminal.

screens.name: availability
steps: Open rg-contoso-monitoring > the Application Insights resource > Investigate > Availability
Show the orders-api-healthz standard test with green results from the five European locations (West Europe, North Europe, France Central, UK South, UK West)
Hover one dot so location and duration are visible
mask: tenant name/domain in the top bar and account menu
app host name in the web test

teardown: az group exists --name rg-contoso-monitoring   # false when done
